notes.title: HOT New Update! v2.3 is LIVE!
notes.content:
http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/Update_2-3_Announcement.jpg

You may have noticed a jump in the ːTinyːinyːKːeep version numbers (the last being v1.5). Since then various incremental changes have been made over the last month or two but most of them were to test out functionality for the mobile versions. That said, check out and see what version 2.3 has in store for you!

Update v2.3

   You can now gain Double Fireproof if you have the Baby Dragon unlocked on New Game+. The second fireproof prevents you from being set on fire, so you're not even affected by slowdown.
   The camera smoothing code has been rewritten and should now vary less across the different framerates and graphics set ups.
   By popular demand, you can now choose to Restart Game or Exit To Main Menu upon dying.
   General bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: TinyKeep OST! Update 1.5 is Alive!
notes.content:
http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/OST-Announcement.jpg

The full original soundtrack for TinyKeep, which is composed, orchestrated and mastered by Will Bedford, is now available for purchase!

Album artwork by Phi Dinh.
Awful puns by Ben Jones.
Track 14 uses some in-game sounds by Jey Kazi.

1. TinyKeep
2. Saviour In The Dark
3. All Locked Up With Someplace To Go
4. Cobb and Twist
5. Pershdal Dungeons
6. A Bone Of Contention
7. Orcward Silences
8. The Party Shop
9. Sulphur So Good
10. An Alternate Dimension
11. The Final Choice
12. I Have A Bone To Pick With You
13. Credits
14. The Spinal Tap-Dance
15. Trailer (Bonus Track)

Grab all 15 amazing tracks here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/344530
Update v1.5:

   Game automatically restarts on death instead of making the player go through the character creation and intro again.
   Improved shrine messaging.
   Baby dragon fire no longer damages player in New Game+ mode - player is automatically given the Fireproof buff when becoming the "Mother of Dragons"
   Various physics and performance tweaks

notes.title: TINYKEEP v1.2 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
http://digitaltribegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/TK_Update_1-2.jpg

Since launch, Phigames has been heavily involved in the forums and keeping an eye on the most requested features by the players. Version 1.2 brings with it a some major new additions as well as some tweaks and fixes that enhance the TinyKeep experience.

New Features

  Temporary Save and Quit
  Unlockable Level Selects
  Custom Control Remapping
  25 New Achievements
  Disable screen shake option
  Disable Xbox360 controller prompts

Tweaks

  Lighter corpses
  Coin collection radius increase
  Improved/clearer Xbox360 controller diagram

Fixes

  A handful of level seeds were unwinnable as the player was too "fat" to fit in some of the gaps in the wall. This no longer happens
  Fixed some unwinnable cave areas
  Pause menu can now be closed with ESC


Find out more TinyKeep v1.2 details over on the developer's blog here: http://blog.tinykeep.com/2014/10/tinykeep-v12-is-here.html.
